text.p: The MicroCap Fund Inc and broker dealer Commonwealth Associates said they agreed to settle the entire lawsuit MicroCap brought against Commonwealth, its chairman Michael Falk and others.
In June, Commonwealth said it and Falk filed a $20 million defamation suit against the MicroCap Fund and others.
It was in respoponse to a federal lawsuit MicroCap filed in April which allegedly claimed the broker dealer committed fraud, breached fiduciary duties and violated the Investment Company Act.
Commonwealth Associates underwrote MicroCap's initial public offering in 1993.
The companies said all suits were settled, but terms were not disclosed. The defendents have denied they would have any liability in the action, they said.
MicroCap said the parties decided to settle to avoid litigation costs. The companies also said they agreed to jointly pursue claims against others, which might yield additonal revenue for MicroCap.
